fields.statement: Verifier at ddcc0cf53, detached checkout. Ran go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestShipCheckStabilityRecord|TestFlakyTestBugs|TestTrimFailureLog' -v: all PASS. Subtests cover each acceptance point: 'subtests by full name' (a log with '--- FAIL: TestFoo' and an indented '--- FAIL: TestScripts/bar', rerun green) records Flakes [TestFoo TestScripts/bar] and no Infra; 'unknown step' records Infra ['scripts (4/4) / UNKNOWN STEP'] and no flake; 'no job or step' records Infra ['CI run 42']; 'red after rerun' records red with no flakes (the code sets Flakes/Infra only on the green branch of recordSettledCI, so Infra is empty too); 'old record reads job / step flakes as infra' splits ['test / Run','CI run 9','TestA'] into Flakes [TestA] and Infra on read; TestFlakyTestBugs queues bugs for named test flakes and none for an infra-only run (Infra entry or a legacy 'CI run 5' flake). Also ran TestCIStability and TestHealthCIStability (PASS), TestScripts/describe-golden (ok), go vet and gofmt -l on internal/api (clean). Read the diff: failedTestNames in ship.go matches '--- FAIL: <name>' after logText strips the job/step prefix, timestamp and indentation, and drops a parent whose subtest is named; shipFailedTests sends a log that names no test to infra; CIRun.normalized moves 'job / step' and 'CI run' flakes into Infra on read, and ciVerdict, ciFlakeCounts and watchdogFlakyTests all use it.
